description: This file contains unit tests for the SlotterUtil class, specifically testing the fillListByInitials method which processes a list of Note objects and inserts SectionItem objects based on initials. It uses JUnit and Robolectric for testing Android components.

classes.name: SlotterUtilTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SlotterUtil, testing the fillListByInitials method with different note lists.

methods.name: fillListByInitials_shouldAddSectionItems
methods.description: Tests that fillListByInitials correctly adds SectionItem objects when notes with different initial letters are provided.

methods.name: fillListByInitials_shouldAcceptEmptyTitles
methods.description: Tests that fillListByInitials handles notes with empty titles without errors.
